messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a three‑day weekend; those falling on a weekend already count as a “long weekend” for many people):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Status |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Already a weekend |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Monday | Yes |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Already a weekend |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Yes |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Monday | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Monday | Yes |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Yes |

If you’re looking at provinces that observe different holidays (e.g., British Columbia has Family Day on March 13), let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly!
